message:
We’ll keep invoice documents and extracted data in Australia, including processing, backups and sensitive logs. Let’s propose Sydney (australia-southeast1); service/model availability and residency remain unverified, with no overseas failover proposed.

**Does your existing accounting API also store and process invoice data only in Australia?** This determines whether approved delivery meets that boundary; for example, “yes, Australia only” or “not sure”.

followUp.question: Does your existing accounting API also store and process invoice data only in Australia?
followUp.why: Approved delivery sends extracted invoice data to that service, so its location determines whether the complete workflow meets the Australian boundary.
followUp.example: Yes, Australia only; or not sure.

proposal.title: Apply Australian residency and propose Sydney placement
proposal.body: Preserve the complete invoice workflow, existing systems, IDs and connections. Propose Sydney (australia-southeast1), pending regional service/model and destination-policy verification; this is not an accepted region decision. Keep documents, extracted fields, processing, sensitive logs, backups and recovery copies within Australia. No overseas failover or global model endpoint is proposed. Regional availability, zonal recovery, staff access location and accounting residency remain unverified.

next.name: Asynchronous document intake
next.requirements: Users upload PDF invoices. Extract the supplier, invoice date, total and currency into a review queue. Delivery can repeat; retries must not create duplicate invoices. A reviewer approves a result before it is sent to our existing accounting API. Use Google Cloud. Recommend a coherent system and the engineering choices. Ask only a small material business question when needed; do not make me configure the system.

data.label: Staff uploaders and reviewers
data.description: Existing staff using browsers to upload invoices, inspect extracted fields and source evidence, and approve the exact reviewed revision. Client reference outside provisioning scope; staff sign-in and reviewer authorization are enforced by the application.

data.label: Invoice intake, review and approved delivery
data.description: Proposed composed delivery unit on Google Cloud Run: browser/API, background worker and isolated PDF/OCR parser. Owns Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL transactional queue/outbox and review state, private versioned Google Cloud Storage originals, regional Vertex AI extraction, staff sign-in, SQL user/reviewer membership and separate keyless workload identities. Returns supplier, invoice date, total, currency, source evidence and processing status in the review UI. Parser alone sees untrusted PDF bytes and has no database, model or accounting identity. Persist intake identity and results; commit state and queued work atomically, fence worker leases and recover stalled work. Bind approval to the exact source/result revision and destination contract; edits invalidate approval. Send only approved payloads using a durable operation ID and stable payload identity. Retry only within a verified accounting idempotency contract; uncertain outcomes pause for reconciliation rather than creating a new send. Owns bounded retries, audit events, monitoring, alerts, retention and restore/reconciliation operating tasks. Proposed defaults: PDFs up to 10 MB/100 pages and 90-day retention eligibility, subject to backup/version-window review. Required boundary: documents and extracted data remain stored and processed in Australia, including temporary parser data, model requests/results, sensitive logs, database backups, object versions and recovery copies. Sydney (australia-southeast1) is proposed, not accepted or verified. Verify Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, storage, selected Vertex AI model, private networking, quotas, processing geography and zonal recovery before implementation approval. Do not silently use global model endpoints, overseas replication or overseas failover. Model retention/caching/logging policy, staff identity/access geography and accounting residency/adapter acceptance remain unresolved. This capability is not evidence of deployment or combined-system validation.

data.label: Existing accounting API
data.description: Client-owned existing accounting service; reference only, never recreated or modified by this design. Receives only reviewer-approved invoice payloads. Its adapter must independently pass normalized-action-v1 acceptance for authentication, schema, durable idempotency, stable operation/payload identity and outcome reconciliation. Native vendor compatibility and deployment location are unknown. Australian storage and processing of submitted invoice data must be established before enabling delivery; do not assume the existing service satisfies the residency boundary.

edges.label: HTTPS: upload PDF, review fields/status, approve revision
HTTPS: approved invoice + stable operation ID; receipt/reconciliation

requirementDrafts.rationale: Prevents an Australian application placement from concealing overseas model processing, backups, logging or accounting delivery. Availability and destination-policy evidence are still required.
requirementDrafts.basis: “Keep documents and extracted data in Australia; flag unverified service availability.” The invoice-workflow processes and stores invoices and sends approved fields to existing-accounting.
requirementDrafts.statement: Invoice documents and extracted data shall remain stored and processed in Australia across application, parser, model, database, object versions, sensitive logs, backups, recovery and accounting delivery. Regional service/model availability and processing policies shall remain explicitly unverified until supported by destination-specific evidence; overseas routing or fallback shall not be enabled.

decisionUpdates.subject: data.country
decisionUpdates.sourceText: Keep documents and extracted data in Australia; flag unverified service availability.

skills.name: Architecture composition and engineering judgment
skills.summary: Choose and compose blocks through responsibility, contracts, state, identity, failure modes and trade-offs; verify the complete system.
skills.source: AtMem AI Architect reviewed specialist guidance

skills.name: AI architecture and discovery
skills.summary: Clarify outcome, users, existing systems, data ownership and constraints. Evolve the diagram incrementally. Derive functional requirements and propose measurable quality targets as assumptions needing confirmation. Compare clouds against the actual requirements; do not assume an enterprise identity provider or a vendor. Keep proposed and accepted decisions distinct.
skills.source: AtMem AI Architect reviewed specialist guidance

skills.name: Security and reliability
skills.summary: Check data classification, residency, access boundaries, encryption choices, approval of automated actions, reliability and recovery. A drawn control is not enforcement evidence. Explain missing controls and tests. Propose requirements from the components and paths; mark default targets as suggestions, never existing company policy.
skills.source: AtMem AI Architect reviewed specialist guidance

skills.name: Google Cloud AI architecture guidance
skills.summary: Match model runtime, retrieval, storage, identity and network boundaries to the project. Distinguish architecture guidance from validated commands. Verify regional model availability, quotas and residency before estimating/deploying. The pinned platform architecture reference has additional companion manuals; those commands are not enabled in AtMem AI Architect.
